pr.body:
Fixes #180
Fixes #450

## What / why
- `multiBitFormat` (`formatValue`, `parseValue`, `DisplayFormat`) imports nothing: no React, no DOM. So it moves from `src/components/ui/` to `src/simulation/`. `signalDisplay` now imports it from the same directory (`./multiBitFormat`), and `MultiBitInput` imports it downward (`@/simulation/multiBitFormat`). There is still one copy of the logic.
- Why `src/simulation` and not `src/core`: under `core-through-index`, both callers could reach a `src/core` module only through `src/core/index.ts`, and that would widen the pinned engine surface. `src/simulation` has no such rule and already holds the width helpers (`busOps`). The module stays out of `src/simulation/index.ts` because it is presentation, not engine surface. That file's comment and the `REPO_MAP.md` line said `signalDisplay` imports from `components/`, so both now say what is true.
- The test file moved without a byte changed (`R100`), and it now runs in the `node` Vitest project.
- **Ratchet:** `pnpm run lint:layers:shrink` took the baseline from **72 → 71 rows**. It removed exactly one row, `engine-no-ui: src/simulation/signalDisplay.ts → src/components/ui/multiBitFormat.ts`, and added none; `compareRatchetBaseline` run locally on the two files reads `shrank`. `engine-no-ui` now has 0 rows, so any new `src/simulation` → UI import fails `lint:layers`. That guard covers acceptance criterion 1. The script's `eslint --prune-suppressions` step also rewrote `eslint-suppressions.json`, but only to drop its trailing newline, so I reverted that file.

## Also in this PR: #450 (coordinator's ruling)
This is the first PR that shrinks the ratchet, and it broke one test from #432. `scripts/pr-hygiene.logic.test.mjs` ("reproduces the measured reset") reads the **live** baseline but pinned `{ base: 72, head: 73 }`. It now derives the count from `realRows().length` and first asserts that count is `> 0`, so it cannot pass vacuously. It still asserts `absorbed` and names the absorbed row. I checked it three ways: it passes on a 71-row baseline (this branch), passes on a 72-row one (`main`), and fails on `[]` with `expected 0 to be greater than 0`. That fix is its own commit (`test(pr-hygiene)`): 2 lines added, 1 removed. I grepped `scripts/pr-hygiene.*` and `scripts/layer-ratchet.logic.test.mjs` and found no other count pinned on the live file. The remaining pins (`{2,1}`, `{2,2}`, `{3,2}`, `28`) are all on fixtures.
